newsitem.title: UK: ROYAL SUN GAINS AS RESULTS TOP FORECASTS.
newsitem.headline: ROYAL SUN GAINS AS RESULTS TOP FORECASTS.

text.p: Shares in British insurer Royal & Sun Alliance Group rose on Thursday after half-year results topped market forecasts.
The shares were up 13-1/2p to 536p soon after the market opened.
"They were a very good set of numbers, certainly better than we were looking for," said one trader. "I'm sure there will be upgrades to come but not until after the meeting."

Royal Sun said first half pre-tax profits came to 556 million stg, up from 503 million stg the previous year and better than top expectations of 465 million stg. Most analysts were forecasting profits of around 445 million.
The strength of sterling took 25 million pounds off the headline profit figure but the company said its priority was to build shareholder value.

The dividend was raised 10 percent to 7.15 pence per share and the company reaffirmed its commitment to a programme of share buy backs. To date the company has purchased 32.1 million shares, less than half the amount it may be planning to repurchase.
